title: Terms
summary: Rogue hires V to carry a sealed note to an old merc in Kabuki, and V has to name the fee first.
description: Rogue has a sealed note that has to reach an old merc in Kabuki. She is hiring V for the errand, and V has to name the price first.

start.bringUp: You have a job for V and a sealed note that has to reach a man in Kabuki, and you will not ask V as a friend. Bring up, briefly and in your own way, that you are hiring V and that V should name the price.

booth.name: the private booth upstairs at the Afterlife

R1.open.01.text: I'm not asking you as a friend. I'm hiring you. Sit.

R1.open.02.text: A note. Sealed. It goes to a man in Kabuki. He'll be at a noodle stall.

R1.open.03.text: Price is what we haggle. Don't insult me by working for free.

R1.open.04.text: That's a number. Fine. You argued it well. Don't make a habit of it.

R1.open.05.text: No. That's not how this works. Take the money.

R1.bark.arrive.a.text: He's the one by the red lantern. Hands in his pockets. Don't stare.

R1.merc.01.text: A bar tab. She owes me a drink since a night neither of us should have walked out of.

R1.close.01.text: A bar tab. Of course it was. ... Thank you. Don't say anything about it.

R1.close.02.text: A coaster. Keep your mouth shut. ... I'll remember that.

g1.asks: Name your number. And don't tell me you don't have one.
g1.know: You have the Afterlife's private booth, the errand: a sealed note for a man at a noodle stall in Kabuki, and a fee between 300 and 1,200 eddies. You respect people who negotiate, and you will settle the number once V has named one.
g1.secret: The note is a bar tab, and an apology you cannot send through anyone you employ.
g1.wants: You want V to take the job at a fair price, and you will respect V for arguing it.

g2.asks: Does she ask about me? Or just about the money?
g2.know: You sent V to the old merc with the note. He has not forgiven you, and he will hand back a coaster or a cold word depending on what V tells him.
g2.secret: He never stopped caring where you were.
g2.wants: You want V to carry back an honest word.

stages.label: Rogue hires V in the Afterlife booth
stages.objective: Talk terms with Rogue in the Afterlife booth
stages.know: V is in the Afterlife's private booth upstairs. You are about to hire V for an errand with a price, and you will make V haggle it. You have not said what the note is.
stages.wants: V to name a fee and take the job.

stages.label: V carries the note to the noodle stall in Kabuki
stages.objective: Carry Rogue's sealed note to the Kabuki noodle stall
stages.know: You sent V to a noodle stall in Kabuki with a sealed note for an old merc you have not spoken to in years. You have not told V that the note is a bar tab.
stages.wants: V to hand over the note and carry back an honest word.

do.who: old merc in a grey coat, has not forgiven Rogue

report.memory: You carried a sealed note from Rogue to an old solo in Kabuki, and he answered with a coaster.
report.history: Rogue brings up the tab when old debts come up.

report-cold.memory: You carried a sealed note from Rogue to an old solo in Kabuki, and he gave you one cold word back.

torn.memory: You carried a sealed note from Rogue to Kabuki, and the old solo would not take it.

stood-up.memory: You did not take Rogue's job, and she did not wait for you at the booth.
